description: Manage Linktree profiles, links, appearance, and analytics via the Model Context Protocol.

serverInfo.name: Linktree MCP
serverInfo.description: Manage Linktree profiles, links, appearance, and analytics via the Model Context Protocol.

tools_preview.name: list_accessible_profiles
tools_preview.description: List all Linktree profiles the authenticated user can access across direct accounts and workspaces.

tools_preview.name: get_account
tools_preview.description: Retrieve Linktree profile details (display name, bio, avatar, username).

tools_preview.name: update_account_profile
tools_preview.description: Update a profile's display name and/or bio.

tools_preview.name: get_links
tools_preview.description: Retrieve the ordered list of links on a Linktree profile, including link-app metadata.

tools_preview.name: add_link
tools_preview.description: Add a new URL-backed link to a profile.

tools_preview.name: update_link
tools_preview.description: Update an existing top-level link's title, URL, or active state.

tools_preview.name: move_link
tools_preview.description: Reorder a top-level link within a profile.

tools_preview.name: delete_link
tools_preview.description: Delete a top-level link from a profile.

tools_preview.name: get_appearance
tools_preview.description: Retrieve a profile's appearance settings (colors, fonts, button styles, background).

tools_preview.name: update_appearance
tools_preview.description: Update a profile's appearance (colors, fonts, button styles, background).

tools_preview.name: get_social_links
tools_preview.description: Retrieve a profile's social icon links and their display order.

tools_preview.name: upsert_social_link
tools_preview.description: Create or update a social icon link for a supported platform.

tools_preview.name: get_account_analytics
tools_preview.description: Retrieve account-level analytics (views, clicks, CTR, trend data).

tools_preview.name: get_link_analytics
tools_preview.description: Retrieve analytics for a specific link (clicks, views, CTR, trend data).

tools_preview.name: get_knowledge_base
tools_preview.description: Retrieve a profile's AI chatbot knowledge base entries.

tools_preview.name: get_workspaces_for_user
tools_preview.description: List all workspaces the authenticated user is a member of.

tools_preview.name: get_workspace_profiles
tools_preview.description: List all Linktree profiles belonging to a workspace.
